description: Parcs de stationnement de la Ville de Gap is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Gap-Tallard-Durance. Location of car parks located in the territory of the City of Gap: secure parking, free unenclosed parking, park-and-ride facilities. More information on parking in the territory The data are updated once a year. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Gap-Tallard-Durance. The portal shows the English title as "Parking lots of the City of Gap" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Gap-Tallard-Durance. Its keywords include stationner, aire-de-stationnement, parking. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
